course.title: MEng (Hons) Electrical and Electronic Engineering | University of Nottingham Malaysia
quotes: MEng (Hons) in Electrical and Electronic Engineering
Full-time: 4 years Part-time: Not available Start date: September 2027 Malaysian fee: RM58,000 per year International fee: RM69,000 per year*
Enjoy peace of mind with our Fixed Tuition Fee policy, pay the same amount each year until you graduate.
*For International Students, a 6% Sales and Service Tax (SST) will apply to non-Malaysian citizens from 1 July 2025.
A Level BBC, including Mathematics and Physics, excluding Critical Thinking and General Studies.
IB Diploma 26 points with 5 and 4 at Higher Level, including either Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches (HL) or Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation (HL), plus Physics (HL).
Senior School Certificate Examination (CBSE) / Indian School Certificate (CISCE) - Class XII 78% average from the best four subjects, including Mathematics and Physics at 80% and 70%, respectively.
Advance Placement (AP) 4, 4, 3, including AP Calculus and AP Physics.
IELTS (Academic): 6.0 (with no less than 5.5 in each element)
